_README: Q293 corrections to the muscle data, one row each; applied by scripts/anatomy/q293/audit_q293.py apply
geometry_vs_textbook: cited movement signs the Q284 computed moment arms contradict on (nearly) every page, with why the citation is kept

references.gray: Gray's Anatomy for Students 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

smutz1998.citation: Smutz WP, Kongsayreepong A, Hughes RE, Niebur G, Cooney WP, An KN. Mechanical advantage of the thumb muscles. J Biomech 1998;31(6):565-70
smutz1998.note: Cadaveric tendon-excursion moment arms of the thumb muscles at the IP, MCP and CMC joints (seven hands). The abstract gives each muscle's overall role; the joints a muscle crosses are those of its course (Gray's / Moore).
smutz1998.quote: It was found that the flexor pollicis longus was a pure flexor while flexor pollicis brevis was an adductor as well as a flexor, the extensor pollicis longus was an extensor and an adductor, extensor pollicis brevis was an extensor and a mild abductor, the abductor pollicis longus was an extensor as well as an abductor, the abductor pollicis brevis was mainly an abductor, the adductor pollicis was a major flexor as well as an adductor, and the opponents pollicis was a flexor and an abductor.

abductor_pollicis_longus|thumb_cmc|abd|+.kept: cited (Gray's; Smutz 1998: 'an extensor as well as an abductor')
abductor_pollicis_longus|thumb_cmc|abd|+.reason: The rig's thumb CMC directions were checked by forward kinematics on Base · Male and Combined · Female: +20 deg CMC flexion brings the thumb tip 19-22 mm closer to the 5th metacarpal (flexion across the palm), +20 deg palmar abduction lifts it off the palm -- the labels and the simulation are right. The computed CMC moment arms of EVERY thumb muscle come out with the opposite sign (flexors negative, extensors positive), i.e. a systematic artefact of the Q284 path model at the thumb CMC, not of the cited actions. Kept: the cited action (Smutz 1998 tendon-excursion moment arms; Moore; Gray's).

tibialis_posterior|ankle|dp|-1.reason: Its tendon runs in the groove behind the medial malleolus, close to the rig's malleolar-tip axis; the Q284 wrap puts the computed path on the wrong side of that axis on every page (dorsiflexion sign). Plantarflexion is the textbook action of tibialis posterior; kept.

external_oblique|thoracic|rot|-1.kept: cited (Gray's; Moore: contralateral rotation of the trunk)
external_oblique|thoracic|rot|-1.reason: A broad sheet: the centre line of its mesh (the Q284 path) does not follow the fibres from the ribs down and forward to the linea alba, so the computed thoracic rotation sign is unreliable (agrees on 1 of 11 structures). Textbook kept.

obliquus_capitis_inferior|cervical|rot|+.kept: cited (Gray's: rotates the atlas and the head to the same side)
obliquus_capitis_inferior|cervical|rot|+.reason: The rig lumps the head and the whole neck in one cervical region; a muscle from C2 to C1 acts at the atlanto-axial joint only (agrees on 4 of 12 structures). Textbook kept.
